headline: Is Declan Rice the Ideal Saka Replacement?
body: I'm quite surprised to not hear this man right here as the frontrunner for the replacement to Saka owners in FPL. Plays 90 minutes every game, has returned in all but one of his starts, and is a consistent defcon and g/a threat. He seems like such a secure pick and a really easy swap from Saka, while maintaining a piece of the arsenal attack. Is there reasons as to why he has not been mentioned as much to the likes of taveneier, manzambi, etc.?   submitted by   /u/FishAffectionate5520 [link]   [comments]
